draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Bangalore Palace! The palace grounds here are surrounded by old money, and just a 10 min walk away is Jayamahal Palace, which started out around 1892 as Arni Hall, owned by the Jagirdar of Arni in Tamil Nadu. Today it's a heritage hotel.
draft.hungryLine: For a proper meal head to Cunningham Road, and for a late-night cup of tea there's a 24 hour tea shop near Russell Market in Shivajinagar.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Jayamahal Palace Hotel is a 10 min walk, and the National Military Memorial is about 24 minutes on foot. Art fans should take a short drive to the Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk over to the National Military Memorial, a quiet memorial park honouring soldiers who died serving the nation.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Anugraha, the Chief Minister's official home about 15 minutes from here, is believed to have a vaastu fault, and several chief ministers have had it renovated before moving in.

spots.name: Jayamahal Palace Hotel
spots.detail: 10 min walk · The old Arni Hall from around 1892, now a heritage hotel

spots.name: National Military Memorial
spots.detail: 24 min walk · Memorial park set up in 2013 for the nation's fallen soldiers

spots.name: Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath
spots.detail: Short drive · 18 galleries, with Mysore paintings and leather puppets

legends.title: The house with a vaastu fault
legends.body: Bengaluru folks say the Chief Minister's official residence has a vaastu fault. That's why several chief ministers insisted on renovations before they moved in.

tips.title: Come in January for art.
tips.body: Each January the Chitrakala Parishath holds Chitra Santhe, a festival of affordable art with the motto Art for All.

tips.title: Expect two ticket prices.
tips.body: Bengaluru attractions often charge foreigners a lot more than locals, so don't be surprised at the gate.

story.title: Trains arrive
story.body: Bengaluru Cantonment railway station opened with trains to Jolarpettai, run by the Madras Railway. The 149 km broad-gauge line linked the Cantonment to Vellore district.

story.title: Arni Hall
story.body: Jayamahal Palace was first known as Arni Hall, owned by the Jagirdar of Arni from Tamil Nadu. It's now a 4-star heritage hotel.

story.title: Blackpally becomes Shivajinagar
story.body: The old Blackpally, also called Tasker Town or Dandu, was renamed Shivajinagar after the Maratha Emperor Shivaji. Councillor N R Murthy pushed for the name in the city corporation.

story.title: Gandhi Bhavan
story.body: President S. Radhakrishnan opened Gandhi Bhavan, a museum with rare photos and letters of Mahatma Gandhi. It still hosts meetings on Gandhian values.

story.title: Remembering soldiers
story.body: The Government of Karnataka set up the National Military Memorial to honour soldiers who died serving the nation and their families.

food.name: Shezan
food.detail: Cunningham Rd · Indian, Chinese and Continental, known for excellent steaks

food.name: Savera Tea Shop
food.detail: Near Russell Market, Shivajinagar · 24 hour tea, Suleimani and biscuits
